primary_decision.rule: for each pool: composite < 1.0 and both co-primary point estimates do not exceed that pool's classical baseline; paired origin bootstrap intervals reported. The primary decision uses the Gaussian-VAR-base pool against VAR-GARCH (identical S&P Phase 2F rule); the Student-t-VAR-base pool against Student-t VAR is the prespecified strong-baseline secondary decision.

secondary_decision.rule: for each pool: composite < 1.0 and both co-primary point estimates do not exceed that pool's classical baseline; paired origin bootstrap intervals reported. The primary decision uses the Gaussian-VAR-base pool against VAR-GARCH (identical S&P Phase 2F rule); the Student-t-VAR-base pool against Student-t VAR is the prespecified strong-baseline secondary decision.
